paragraphs.text: Greta is a female Human warrior from Eldraine .
Greta is based on Gretel of "Hansel and Gretel."

When they were young, Greta and her brother Hanlon were lured to Sweettooth Village. There, they discovered a slew of vicious creatures made out of sweets. Greta escaped, but her brother was eaten by a cannibalistic witch. Seeking vengeance, she became a witch hunter.

Returning to Sweettooth Village, Greta stormed the village with axe in hand and began slaying candy horrors, seeking vengeance on the witch behind the operation. While fighting, she discovered a young boy stuck in the village. She rescued him, able to save someone who was trapped like she once was.
